Allegations of Voter Fraud

Mail-In Ballot Irregularities: Critics have expressed concern about the unprecedented expansion of mail-in voting, particularly citing instances where signature verification processes may have been inconsistent across different jurisdictions. Judicial and Administrative Interference: Some challengers have expressed concern about judicial decisions that modified election procedures, arguing that courts overstepped their authority by changing rules that should be determined by legislatures. Restoring Public Confidence in Democracy
